text:
sasha.marketing: Quick ask — can we finalize a short Gateway Slate one-pager that covers: deployment-mode comparison (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), SLA highlight, security checklist, and two landing headlines for blog + webinar? Need it for next week's launch pack. :rocket:

omar.field: I can draft the field-facing bullets. Can we include an inbound routing snippet for leads (what tags to add)? e.g., utm_source=enterprise & tag sla=dedicated

lei.product: I'll add the model/latency callouts and a tiny benchmark blurb. Keep numbers conservative — median P90 latency and cost delta for ded vs hosted.

jess.growth: For the headlines: 1) "Predictable Inference for Regulated Teams" 2) "Ship LLM Features with Enterprise SLAs" — short, will A/B test in webinar signup flow.

raj.security: Add a security one-liner about VPC, KMS/HSM, and audit logs. Also call out SOC2 + optional on-prem. I can approve copy for compliance.

sasha.marketing: Awesome. Omar, can you add an inbound routing line like: "Inbound tagging: source=marketing, campaign=enterprise_gateway, route=field-sales if tag=sla:dedicated OR route=enterprise-sdr if tag=trial" — we just need the exact phrasing for ops.

omar.field: On it. Also proposing a small matrix: recommended use-case per deploy mode (fast prototyping -> Hosted, high-throughput -> Dedicated, regulated -> Private). One-row pros/cons.

lei.product: For benchmarks, I'll include sample numbers: Hosted median P90 120ms, Dedicated P90 70ms, Private (on-prem tuned) P90 60-90ms depending on infra. Plus a note: batching & KV cache can reduce token cost by ~30%.

jess.growth: For the webinar narrative, we'll lead with customer pain (unpredictable cost/latency), demo the routing/fallback story, then close on SLAs + security. I'll draft a one-paragraph abstract.

raj.security: Add the required legal approval line: "Subject to contract and SOC2 attestation; Private deployments require customer infra review." I'll sign off once final copy reflects that.

deploy-bot: New doc created: link to /google-drive/marketing/gateway-slate-draft-v1.docx (owner: sasha.marketing)

sasha.marketing: Timeline: draft v1 by EOD tomorrow, internal review Thursday, ship final one-pager + 2 blog headlines by Friday COB. Assignments: Omar = field bullets + routing, Lei = benchmarks, Jess = headlines + webinar abstract, Raj = security/legal signoff.

omar.field: Got it. I'll include quick callouts for sales enablement (talking points and suggested demo script).

lei.product: I'll keep benchmark text non-technical and add an appendix link to the full benchmark deck for folks who want details.

sasha.marketing: Perfect. When v1's in Drive ping me here with a short diff. We'll also prepare a condensed slide for the sales kickoff. :thumbsup:
